title: Residue separability over a uniformizer-root DVR base
statement: Let B,A,U,T be DVR domains [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring], with a B-algebra structure on A, a local B-algebra U, and a local A-algebra T. Let pi be an irreducible element of B, let e be a natural number which is a unit in B, and suppose there is theta in A with theta^e=pi. Suppose m_B U=m_U^e and k(U)/k(B) is separable [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Let E be a finite separable extension of Frac(B) [def-pc-field-extension] with compatible B- and U-algebra structures, making it the fraction field of U. Let F be a field and an A-algebra, generated over A by the image of a field map iE:E->F compatible with B. Give F a T-algebra structure making it the fraction field of T, compatibly with A. Suppose j:U->T is local, agrees on B with B->A->T, and U->T->F equals U->E->F. Then k(T)/k(A) is separable. No finiteness of A over B is assumed.

source.place: Tags 0BRM (more-algebra-lemma-abhyankar), last two paragraphs after the unit-root claim; 09EV (uniformizer-root DVR), 09EQ (further base change), and 09E7 (weakly unramified and residue separable criterion).

proof.text: Invertibility of e excludes e=0. Choose a uniformizer q of U. Rewrite the maximal-ideal power identity as equality of singleton principal ideals, obtaining a unit w with q^e*w=pi in U. Apply the proved standard-root algebra theorem to R=B[t]/(t^e-pi). Lift t to theta in A and compose to rho:R->T.

The compatible B maps show rho(t)^e=(j(q))^e*j(w). Unique factorization cancels equal positive powers in the association relation and supplies a unit y with j(q)y=rho(t). Since j is local, this image lies in m(T); m(R)=(t) then proves rho local. Its factor R->A is consequently local.

Apply the standard-root unramified model theorem with q,w,y,rho. It constructs a local faithful essentially finite type formally unramified R-algebra V and compatible maps k:V->T, iV:Frac(V)->F and iEV:E->Frac(V), with iV composed with iEV=iE.

Every element of range(iE) lies in range(iV), by the displayed field factorization. Monotonicity of Algebra.adjoin transfers the given generation over A to iV. Apply the proved arbitrary DVR compositum base-change theorem to R,V,A,T, obtaining essential finite type and formal unramifiedness of T/A. Mathlib local residue-field separability then gives the requested conclusion.

theorem dvr_uniformizer_root_compositum_residue_isSeparable
    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [IsDomain B] [IsDiscreteValuationRing B]
    (pi : B) (hpi : Irreducible pi)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsDiscreteValuationRing A]
    [Algebra B A]
    (U : Type u) [CommRing U] [IsDomain U] [IsDiscreteValuationRing U]
    [Algebra B U] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap B U)]
    (e : ℕ) (he : IsUnit (e : B))
    (theta : A) (hroot : theta ^ e = algebraMap B A pi)
    (hindexU : (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal B).map (algebraMap B U) =
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal U ^ e)
    (hsep : Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField B) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField U))
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (FractionRing B) E]
    [Algebra B E] [IsScalarTower B (FractionRing B) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (FractionRing B) E] [Algebra.IsSeparable (FractionRing B) E]
    [Algebra U E] [IsFractionRing U E] [IsScalarTower B U E]
    (F : Type u) [Field F] [Algebra A F] (iE : E →+* F)
    (hcomm : ∀ b : B, iE (algebraMap B E b) =
      algebraMap A F (algebraMap B A b))
    (hgen : Algebra.adjoin A (Set.range iE) = ⊤)
    (T : Type u) [CommRing T] [IsDomain T] [IsDiscreteValuationRing T]
    [Algebra A T] [IsLocalHom (algebraMap A T)]
    [Algebra T F] [IsFractionRing T F] [IsScalarTower A T F]
    (j : U →+* T) (hj : IsLocalHom j)
    (hjB : ∀ b : B, j (algebraMap B U b) =
      algebraMap A T (algebraMap B A b))
    (hjE : ∀ c : U, algebraMap T F (j c) = iE (algebraMap U E c)) :
    Algebra.IsSeparable (IsLocalRing.ResidueField A) (IsLocalRing.ResidueField T)
